text:
priya: Heads up — CI started creating atlantis plans before our secret-bootstrap job finished, which caused a bunch of apply failures in the dev cluster. Can someone quick-check GH Actions ordering and ArgoCD sync window?

noah: ugh, saw that. Likely the GHAs run matrix jobs but we forgot to make `terraform-plan` depend on `secrets-bootstrap`.

alex: quick fix is `needs:` in the plan job. also consider a lightweight preflight that validates K8s Secret presence.

priya: any snippets? I can patch the workflow today.

noah: sure — in the workflow: 
```yaml
jobs:
  secrets-bootstrap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: ...

  terraform-plan:
    needs: [secrets-bootstrap]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: ...
```
That will gate plan until secrets are done.

alex: if you have concurrent PRs, also add `concurrency` to avoid interleaved atlantis state races: `concurrency: "infra-${{ github.ref }}"`

priya: good point. we use atlantis for apply. does `needs` hold across matrix children?

noah: it does. but matrix expands per job, they still respect `needs`. for further safety, add a short `wait-for-secret` step that checks `kubectl get secret my-creds -n infra` returning 0.

sam: another failure mode: ArgoCD triggered immediately after terraform apply but before k8s manifests were pushed to the repo (race between artifact publish and argocd webhook). We added a small backoff in prod for that.

kevin: on ArgoCD side, you can configure `timeout.reconciliation` and `resource.customizations` in `argocd-cm` but the nicer way is to use an explicit sync-wave and a `syncHook` in the app manifests. Example snippet: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: argocd-cm
data:
  resource.customizations: |
    configmaps/Secret: 
      ignoreDifferences: |
        jsonPointers: ["/data"]
```
(Not exact for secrets, but shows where to tune.)

infra-bot: CI | secrets-bootstrap succeeded (job #4827) :white_check_mark:

priya: quick question on secrets wiring — we use SOPS + KMS. If secrets-bootstrap writes to an s3 path, is the GH Action ephemeral runner guaranteed to upload before subsequent jobs read?

noah: yes if it's the same workflow and you use `actions/upload-artifact` + `actions/download-artifact` between jobs. For cross-workflow choreography it's riskier.

alex: alternative is to use a persistent store (s3) + a short polling-check in dependent jobs: `aws s3 ls s3://infra-bootstrap/ready.flag` then proceed. keeps things explicit.

priya: ok — plan: 1) add `needs: [secrets-bootstrap]` to terraform-plan, 2) add `concurrency` key per-branch, 3) add `wait-for-secret` kubectl check step, 4) add tiny artifact publish for proof-of-publish. I'll open a PR with the workflow patch.

sam: also update Atlantis repo config to ensure `autoplan` only triggers for changed modules (reduce noise).

kevin: and I'll check argocd app sync-windows — maybe add a 30s post-apply delay for dev apps to absorb publishing lag.

priya: thanks everyone. I'll ping the PR here when ready for review. :pray:

noah: great — if you want I can review CI YAML.

alex: also run a small integration where we simulate parallel PRs to validate queueing.

priya: done — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/321 — tagging you all.

infra-bot: PR opened by priya: infra/321 — CI: pending :github:

sam: looking now. :mag:

kevin: nice writeup in the PR description, btw.

priya: thanks — will merge after a quick LGTM and a couple of manual apply checks in staging.

noah: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
